# StreamDek Mobile v2.2.0

Browse a series' episodes without leaving the player, try libVLC as a third player engine, and see
StreamDek's own icons across the navigation bar, the player and Settings. Plex and Jellyfin settings
are tidier, and far fewer videos need to switch engine to get their sound.

## What's New

**Episodes in the player**
While watching a series, open **Episodes** in the player's controls to browse every season without
going back to the title page. The episode you are watching is marked, watched and part-watched
episodes show their progress, and episodes that have not aired yet are labelled. Tap one to switch
to it straight away.

**libVLC player engine**
libVLC joins ExoPlayer and mpv as a third player engine. Choose it in Settings > Player > Default
Player, or switch to it during playback from the player's Engine panel without losing your place.
- Automatic works as before: it starts with ExoPlayer and moves to mpv if a source cannot play.
  libVLC is used only when you choose it.
- If libVLC cannot play a source, StreamDek hands it to another engine and tells you why.
- Sources that need sign-in headers, and protected channels, go straight to ExoPlayer.

**A new look for icons**
The navigation bar, the player and every Settings page now share one set of StreamDek icons, drawn
in the same style. Navigation icons fill in when selected, and each settings row has its own icon
instead of several sharing one. Plex and Jellyfin keep their own marks.

**A highlight that follows you**
The highlight in the navigation bar now slides from one tab to the next when you tap, instead of
jumping. It follows your animation speed setting, and moves at once if you have motion turned off.

## Improvements

**Sound without switching engine**
Films and episodes with Dolby Digital, Dolby Digital Plus, DTS or TrueHD audio now play their sound
in ExoPlayer on phones that have no decoder of their own for them. Before, most of these started
silent for a few seconds and were then handed to mpv. Starting them is quicker as a result, and mpv
is kept for the sources that really need it.

**ExoPlayer tries to recover first**
When ExoPlayer finds a problem with a video's sound, it now tries to put it right itself before
another engine takes over: choosing an audio track that was left unselected, trying another track
when one will not decode, or restarting the audio. Streams whose listing leaves out their audio are
opened again a second way to find it.

**Tidier Plex and Jellyfin settings**
Each server is now a group you can fold away. Remove a single library, or a single server, without
disconnecting everything else.
- Removed Plex servers and libraries are kept under **Removed**, where you can bring them back.
- Removing a Plex server also clears any libraries you had removed from it, so only the server is
  listed under Removed.
- Removing a Jellyfin server signs out of that server alone.
- Nothing is deleted on the server itself.

**More in the player's info panel**
The info panel now shows more where the engine reports it: video profile and bit depth, audio sample
rate, bitrate and language, the current stream bitrate, and frames decoded and dropped.

**Easier on the battery with mpv**
mpv no longer smooths motion between frames on a phone screen, and reports its position less often
while playing. Both reduce the work done during a film without changing how it looks.

**A cleaner player**
The player's drawers no longer have an outline around them, and the progress bar in the Minimal
layout is slightly thicker and easier to see.

## Fixed

- Fixed a new video in ExoPlayer starting without your preferred audio and subtitle languages and
  only switching to them a moment later.

## Quick Setup

- **Episodes:** bring up the player's controls while watching a series and tap Episodes.
- **libVLC:** Settings > Player > Default Player > libVLC, or open Engine in the player to switch
  for the video you are watching.
- **Remove a library or server:** Settings > Sources > Plex or Jellyfin, then tap the remove button
  beside a library, or Remove this server. Bring anything back from Removed.
- **Icons, the navigation highlight and audio:** nothing to set up. These apply automatically after
  updating.

## Good to Know

- Removing a library or a Plex server hides it on this device; it is switched off for your profile
  on every device.
- A few audio formats, such as Dolby AC-4, still play through mpv.
